name: Ravi Bharwani
bio:
Ravi L. Bharwani is an Indonesian director, screenwriter and producer. His debut feature The Rainmaker (2004) travelled to numerous film festivals and received the Asia New Talent Award at the Shanghai International Film Festival in 2005.

In February 2019, 27 Steps of May (2019) premiered at the Plaza Indonesia Film Festival, and was also shown at the Bengaluru International Film Festival (Biffes), the Mar Sharm El Sheikh Asian Film Festival (SAFF) and the Cambodia International Film Festival (CIFF).

credits.title: Secrets
credits.overview: Former sex worker Parni built a peaceful life for her daughter, but her abusive ex resurfaces, threatening to destroy everything she fought to protect.

credits.title: 27 Steps of May
credits.overview: Eight years ago, 14 year old May was raped by a group of men. May’s father is devastated, blaming himself for not being able to keep his daughter safe. Traumatized significantly by this incident, May withdraws completely from life.

credits.title: Hotel Vladivostok
credits.overview: In a hotel overlooking the Sea of Japan, six disparate stories inter-connect giving time a shape, like a series of liquid transparencies, one laid on top of another. Murder, sacrifice, betrayal, longing and regret weave into a tapestry of souls remembering and forgetting.

credits.title: The Rainmaker
credits.overview: A man who is in charge of seeding clouds to bring rain to a parched district becomes obsessed with a traditional singer.

credits.overview: A music disciples learn something mistifying while he learn the symphonies.
